classification.difficultyReason: Read annual interest factors from a supplied table, multiply by the regular payment and subtract total contributions.

inlines.text: The table below shows the future value and interest earned for the following annuities.
Use the table to calculate the

children.label: a
children.prompt: $\$34\,000$ per year for 5 years at 4% p.a. compounded annually.

answer.worked:
For 5 periods at 4%, the table factor is $5.42$.
$$\begin{aligned}FV&=5.42\times34\,000\\FV&=\$184\,280\\I&=184\,280-(34\,000\times5)\\I&=\$14\,280\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: $\$45\,000$ per year for 4 years at 1% p.a. compounded annually.

answer.worked:
For 4 periods at 1%, the table factor is $4.06$.
$$\begin{aligned}FV&=4.06\times45\,000\\FV&=\$182\,700\\I&=182\,700-(45\,000\times4)\\I&=\$2700\end{aligned}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: $\$14\,200$ per year for 5 years at 5% p.a. compounded annually.

answer.worked:
For 5 periods at 5%, the table factor is $5.53$.
$$\begin{aligned}FV&=5.53\times14\,200\\FV&=\$78\,526\\I&=78\,526-(14\,200\times5)\\I&=\$7526\end{aligned}$$
